text: The analysis checked for fire detections using data from four satellites: **VIIRS on SNPP, VIIRS on NOAA-20, VIIRS on NOAA-21, and MODIS**. These sensors provided thermal anomaly detections at resolutions of 375 meters (VIIRS) and 1 kilometer (MODIS). The evaluation covered the entire period from **October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026**, with each sensor fully monitoring the asset every day. No thermal anomalies were detected during this time.
